instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. On an outdoor wooden deck with green trees in the background, three friends stack their hands together in the center. In the left foreground, the man in the gray t-shirt (R3) has his back to the camera. In the center background, the man in the orange t-shirt (R2) smiles. On the right, the woman in the beige hoodie (R4) is in side profile, smiling. They all extend their hands to stack them in a central huddle under warm, natural sunlight.
